mostWorthwhile.text: Building the retina and optic nerve gave names to the light-sensitive lining and its outgoing signal route.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the finished eye parts was understandable but felt like a predictable assembly step.

surprise.text: The retina's nerve fibres gather into one outgoing bundle called the optic nerve.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though most later combinations were the only available choices, and how light becomes a nerve signal wasn't explained.

continue.text: I'd probably continue to see how the model develops, though I'd hope for more meaningful choices and a clearer explanation of how sight works.
